name: North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality
source_citation: NC DEQ Strategic Plan FY 2025-2029 (NC OSBM Public Repository)
mission: To protect and enhance North Carolina's environment and natural resources, and preserve them for the health, well-being and economic benefit of present and future generations.
eligible_applicant_types: Public and State controlled institutions of higher education

goals.title: Protect and Improve Water Quality and Drinking Water Infrastructure
goals.citation: NC DEQ Strategic Plan, Section 2.1, pp. 12-16
goals.description: Ensure clean, reliable drinking water for all North Carolinians, remediate emerging contaminants including PFAS/PFOA, upgrade aging wastewater and stormwater infrastructure, and protect river basins and watersheds.
objectives: Upgrade aging municipal and rural wastewater systems to prevent discharges
Remediate PFAS/PFOA and perfluorinated chemicals in drinking water supplies
Implement nonpoint source watershed restoration in Cape Fear, Neuse, and Tar-Pamlico basins
Strengthen stormwater resilience against severe storm and hurricane flooding

goals.title: Advance Clean Air, Climate Resilience, and Clean Energy Transition
goals.citation: NC DEQ Strategic Plan, Section 2.2, pp. 17-22
goals.description: Reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve ambient air quality, deploy zero-emission technologies, and expand coastal storm and heat resilience across vulnerable communities.
objectives: Reduce stationary and mobile source criteria air pollutants and toxics
Deploy distributed renewable energy and battery storage across state facilities
Implement the NC Clean Energy Plan to achieve power sector carbon neutrality
Enhance community climate risk assessments and extreme weather adaptation

goals.title: Sustainable Land Stewardship, Brownfields Redevelopment, and Waste Reduction
goals.citation: NC DEQ Strategic Plan, Section 2.3, pp. 23-28
goals.description: Remediate contaminated brownfield and Superfund sites, improve solid and hazardous waste reduction, and support sustainable soil and forest conservation.
objectives: Accelerate assessment and cleanup of abandoned industrial and brownfield properties
Prevent chemical spills through rigorous hazardous waste permitting and inspections
Expand municipal waste diversion, composting, and advanced recycling infrastructure
Protect critical soil resources and agricultural buffer zones

goals.title: Coastal Protection, Estuarine Habitats, and Marine Fisheries Management
goals.citation: NC DEQ Strategic Plan, Section 2.4, pp. 29-34
goals.description: Safeguard North Carolina's 300+ miles of coastline, restore oyster reefs and submerged aquatic vegetation, strengthen living shorelines, and sustain commercial/recreational fisheries.
objectives: Restore coastal marshlands, oyster sanctuaries, and seagrass nurseries
Permit nature-based living shorelines to combat coastal erosion and storm surges
Modernize fisheries stock assessments using acoustic and environmental DNA monitoring
Support coastal county waterfront access and resilience infrastructure

goals.title: Environmental Justice, Rural Community Support, and Tribal Partnerships
goals.citation: NC DEQ Strategic Plan, Section 2.5, pp. 35-40
goals.description: Ensure fair treatment and meaningful involvement of all communities, address historic environmental burdens in underserved rural and minority areas, and collaborate with NC tribal nations.
objectives: Target state and federal infrastructure grants to historically distressed communities
Expand multilingual environmental monitoring and public notification systems
Strengthen co-stewardship initiatives with state-recognized North Carolina tribes
Eliminate disparities in safe drinking water access in rural mobile home parks
